scope_limitations: The 28-case JUnit covers the named WhatsApp tests, including empty/null phone BSUID, malformed/conflicting identity, signed public webhook and outbound.
The full CRITICAL job log records 131 compiled PostgreSQL integration files passed; JUnit 28 cases alone is not full application certification.
CI evidence is implementation-internal execution and does not constitute independent audit approval.
